description: Usage meters for AI subscriptions and API plans (Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, SuperGrok, Antigravity, ...) as a Windows tray popover, a TUI and a CLI
notes: Start the tray with 'ai-usagebar-tray' or the Start Menu shortcut 'AI Usage', then turn on 'Start with Windows' from its menu.
Update with 'scoop update ai-usagebar'. The tray's own updater can stay on Notify (the default); let Scoop do the install.
post_uninstall: Get-ChildItem 'HKCU:\Control Panel\NotifyIconSettings' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $icon = Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath; if ($icon.ExecutablePath -like "$root\*") { Remove-Item $_.PSPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
